scopes.description: Full access to Google Drive files for virtual disk mounting and bidirectional syncing via Rclone.
Management of organizational folders and files created or opened by Workspace automations.
Read and write access to Google Sheets for 1NF relational AppSheet backend synthesis.
Read and write access to Google Docs for architectural specification publication.

page.subtitle: Google Cloud Workspace Platform (OAuth Desktop + Service Account)

highlights.title: Armazenamento Local Estrito (Rclone)
highlights.description: As chaves de acesso e refresh tokens OAuth 2.0 residem unicamente no arquivo local rclone.conf da workstation, sem retencao em servidores remotos.

highlights.title: Automacao Workspace & AppSheet (1NF)
highlights.description: Service Account dedicada aos plugins gwork e appsheet do agent-mesh para sintese de planilhas 1NF e documentos corporativos.

highlights.title: Limited Use Compliance
highlights.description: Nenhum dado obtido via APIs do Google e compartilhado com terceiros ou usado para treinamento de IA, cumprindo integralmente a Google API Services User Data Policy.
